DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome causing Pulmonary Artery Atresia (leading to cyanotic heart disease, apnea, and anemia).

The history of maternal non-immunity to rubella, prematurity, and respiratory support aligns with this diagnosis, which often presents with cardiac defects causing systemic hypoxia and secondary anemia. Have you observed any cyanosis (bluish skin) or a heart murmur? REQUEST IMAGES: Echocardiogram.
